title: Steps to top up term deposit monthly interest

steps.text: Login to mobile application,Land on deposits dashboard
Select  “Term Deposit Monthly Interest”type ,Click on details to check deposit details and click on top-up button
Enter required top-up amount ,Click on update interest rate ,then Click 'Next'
Review top-up details , Confirm the “Terms and Conditions” , Confirm the interest rate for related tier ,Then Click 'Confirm'
